name: rsc-reference-fixture
description: RSC Slice E fixture: the minimal-but-real RSC app, built and served entirely by diffpack. A Server Component <Page/> awaits data, embeds a hook-bearing 'use client' island (useState), and passes a 'use server' action into it. diffpack builds all three graphs (client / react-server / ssr); the emitted Node orchestrator (scripts/rsc/rsc-server.mjs) renders the flight, SSR-of-flights it to HTML through a divergent-id ssrModuleMapping, and serves it. scripts/rsc/rsc-check.sh verifies in a real browser (agent-browser): SSR content present, the island hydrates and is interactive, and the server action round-trips over /_action/.
